entries.title: Skim shows whole quotes when covering the article
entries.body: When the Skim panel covers the article, as on a phone, every quote and figure label in its lists appears in full. Before, all but the current one were cut short, with no way to read the rest from Skim. Both lists also check the current item is in view when turning or resizing the screen moves the panel.

entries.title: Tapped cards ignore a close meant for mice
entries.body: Cards opened with a tap or a pen, including Skim's glossary term cards, now ignore a signal to close that is meant for a mouse pointer. This may stop a tapped term card closing on its own on an iPhone, but that is not yet confirmed. On touch-only devices, a tapped term in Skim also no longer stays highlighted afterwards.
